title: A Border for the Extraction
author: Noor Joubert
blurb: Quentin Oyelaran, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
